description: Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha - List of the Roads and Thoroughfares Owned by the Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of roads and thoroughfares as owned by the Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of land coordinates, measurements, and legal procedures for land claims, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership declarations, and land-related legal notifications.
